title: Hereafter: All is Well
description: Wang Ping'an wants to renovate Pervases' temple. You wonder how much progress he's making...

mainQuestExcel.title: Hereafter: All is Well
mainQuestExcel.description: Wang Ping'an wants to renovate Pervases' temple. You wonder how much progress he's making...

dialogs.text: *sigh* This place really is in a terrible state. The pillars are rotten, the planks are broken. At least the statue's still fine...
Why hasn't anyone come to fix this place...
This is turning into quite the project...
You're really fixing this place, huh...
Ah, it's you. I mean, I did say that I was an upstanding citizen now, didn't I?
I must say though, it's a much bigger project than I originally thought...
The designer I brought in to plan the new temple got really fired up the moment I told him that this was a Yaksha's temple.
Not only did he draw up sheet after sheet of plans, he even dragged me off to buy materials.
If he was a few decades younger, I bet he'd insist on working on this himself...
You haven't encountered any danger, have you?
Danger? Oh, you mean monsters and Treasure Hoarders?
You needn't worry. Once they got wind that I was repairing a Yaksha's temple, the Ministry of Civil Affairs assigned some Millelith to help with security.
They've more or less chased all the nearby monsters away.
As for the Treasure Hoarders... They seem to be lying low now that the Millelith are here.
However, the volume of work required to fix this temple has really exceeded my expectations. Turns out we didn't prepare enough materials, so we've had to order in more supplies from the city.
And while those Treasure Hoarders probably wouldn't make a move at the worksite itself, they might lie in ambush along the delivery route to steal the materials along the way.
The Millelith can hold the worksite, no problem. But if the delivery gets attacked by Treasure Hoarders, there's no way they'd be able to respond in time.
Could I ask for a favor from you?
I know how skilled you are. Those Treasure Hoarders are definitely no match for you.
Could you go and teach them a lesson and dissuade them from disrupting our work?
I'll do it.
Thank you. Thank you so much!
Why don't you ask the Millelith?
They're already guarding this worksite day and night. I wouldn't want to tire them out further.
I'll leave this to you then, Traveler.
I recall that this area wasn't the safest...
You mean how the surrounding area is full of monsters and Treasure Hoarders?
Hey, hey! Be careful with that! Don't damage the statue!
*sigh* Looks like the construction work won't be finished any time soon...
Hey, hey! Be careful with that! Don't damage the statue!
*sigh* Looks like the construction work won't be finished any time soon...
P—Please, stop! We've lost! Please, spare us!
Pack it up and get ye gone!
Y—Yes...
But... Dare I ask what we've done to offend you?
Did you find some treasure in this area, by any chance?
We're rebuilding a temple nearby.
R—Rebuilding a temple? In the middle of these mountains?
...There's a temple commemorating an adeptus here!? Wait a minute. Could it be that old house...
Boss, we did see a statue of a bird while we were resting there previously. That must've been...
That's Pervases, one of the Yakshas.
Huh!?
B—Boss! D—Did we really offend an adeptus...?
S—Stop talking nonsense! We didn't know, so that didn't count! It was ignorance! I don't think the adeptus will judge us... Right?
Anyway! Thank you for telling us of the reparations being done on the temple.
We apologize for our previous ignorance and rudeness...
We'll go back and tell the others to give the temple a wider berth.
Boss, shouldn't we go there and light a few sticks of incense to apologize to the adeptus?
Hey, hey, when did you become such a talker! Come on, let's go!
Don't come near this place in the future.
Hello there. Were there Treasure Hoarders about?
Ah, so they left. That's good...
Is there anything else I can help you with?
Hahaha. Thank you for your kindness. But you've already helped me so much. It wouldn't be right.
But if you're willing, it would help if you could find us some <color=#00E1FFFF>Sandbearer Wood</color>. You can consider it your official contribution to the repair work!
It is a good deed, after all. A little personal participation might bring you some good fortune.
I'll go get it for you.
Haha, alright. Just bring the <color=#00E1FFFF>Sandbearer Wood</color> you find straight back to me.
Have other people made any donations to the repair works?
Hmm, to be honest, not many people have. This is a very deserted place, so most people don't know that there is a temple here.
I also suspect that few people now remember the Yaksha known as Pervases...
But enough about that for now. Just bring the <color=#00E1FFFF>Sandbearer Wood</color> you find straight back to me.

flow.stepDescription: Give Wang Ping'an the Sandbearer Wood

dialogs.text: How is it? Did you manage to find the <color=#00E1FFFF>Sandbearer Wood</color>?

flow.stepDescription: Give Wang Ping'an the Sandbearer Wood

dialogs.text: Alright. I'll take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Sandbearer Wood</color> timber.
The temple will take a while more to repair, so I'll remain here for the time being.
If you have the time, you can come by and check on things.
